name: Agnes 3.0 Flash
short: Agnes AI's proprietary high-throughput agentic model with 512K context, 226 tok/s decode, and native tool orchestration. Text + image in; text out.
standout: Ultra-low list pricing ($0.05/$0.15 per 1M), 226 tok/s generation speed, and 512K context window with 92.4% GPQA Diamond accuracy.
tradeoff: Sparse independent benchmark coverage on coding and agentic benchmarks; older flagship now superseded by Agnes 3.0 Pro.
